plan_hash.description: SHA-256 of plan.md at approval time; used to detect post-approval modification

conditions.description: Required when c3_status is CONDITIONAL — describes required changes before exec

source.description: 承認の発行元: cli (bin/plangate approve) または conversation (AI が会話内 APPROVE 後に生成 / TASK-0144)

gate_checks.description: Optional checklist for plan approval gates (standard+ mode recommended). Goal/Scope/Risk checks confirm plan.md existing sections are complete. Not applied to ultra-light/light mode.

goal.description: Goal and success criteria are clearly defined in plan.md

scope.description: In-scope / Out-of-scope boundary is explicitly stated in plan.md

risk.description: Risks & Mitigations are enumerated in plan.md

note.description: Optional human note on gate check results

^_.description: Underscore-prefixed keys are reserved for human-readable annotations. Ignored by machine validation but preserved in the file.

Underscore-prefixed keys are reserved for human-readable annotations (e.g. _review_summary, _schema_reference, _note). They are ignored by machine validation but preserved in the file. Issue #167 / TASK-0053.
